reason: A fixed-supply token does not track an index by itself. Creation and redemption against the underlying basket are required for arbitrage to keep market price near NAV.

basket.weighting: 35% capped verified market capitalization with divisor continuity

rebalance.entryRule: candidate remains eligible for three consecutive observations
rebalance.emergencyRemoval: oracle failure, liquidity breach, exploit, freeze, or legal restriction

issuance.freezeAuthority: separate Squads v4 incident Vault PDA

custody.model: segregated Squads v4 on-chain vault plus regulated operational custody
custody.proofOfReserves: public vault balances and identical daily holdings report attested by at least two independent configured signers

legal.distribution: requires appropriately registered partner if offered to the public

security.smartContractAudit: independent review of integration and relied-on third-party audit reports required
